ACCOUNT_DISABLED.title: Your access was turned off
ACCOUNT_DISABLED.body: Your items are still saved. See what is pending or send diagnostics.

ACCOUNT_IN_OTHER_ORG.title: This account is already in another company
ACCOUNT_IN_OTHER_ORG.body: Use another Google/Apple account or ask the other company to remove you.

ACCOUNT_NOT_INVITED.title: This account isn't in a team yet
ACCOUNT_NOT_INVITED.body: Ask your office for an invite or create your company. Email used: {email}.

ALREADY_RESOLVED.title: This item was already resolved
ALREADY_RESOLVED.body: There is nothing else to do. We refreshed the queue for you.

APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.title: Update AgroRende
APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.body: The update keeps your local data. Then come back to send what is pending.

ASSET_DOUBLE_BOOKED.title: Machine already booked then
ASSET_DOUBLE_BOOKED.body: Your data is saved. Choose another time or another machine.

ASSET_HAS_CRITICAL_REPORT.title: This machine has a critical report
ASSET_HAS_CRITICAL_REPORT.body: The reservation is saved. Review the report and choose another machine or ask the office to review it.
ASSET_HAS_CRITICAL_REPORT.action: Review report or choose another asset

ASSET_NOT_OPERATIONAL.title: Machine is not operational
ASSET_NOT_OPERATIONAL.body: The reservation is saved. Choose an operational machine or ask the office to review it.

ASSET_NOT_RENTABLE.title: This machine cannot go out now
ASSET_NOT_RENTABLE.body: Your data is saved. Check the reason and choose another machine.

ASSET_REPAIR_ALREADY_OPEN.title: A job is already open
ASSET_REPAIR_ALREADY_OPEN.body: Nothing was lost. Attach this report to the existing job or create another job with a reason.

ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Choose another assignee
ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE.body: The work order was not changed. This user is inactive or has not joined yet.

CONFLICT.title: This record changed
CONFLICT.body: Review the newer changes before saving. Your typed fields were kept.

COST_SEASON_MISSING.title: Choose a season for this cost
COST_SEASON_MISSING.body: The cost was not posted. Pick a season to keep reports correct.

CSV_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED.title: Could not read this CSV
CSV_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED.body: No data was imported. Save it again and upload the file once more.

CSV_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.title: Review the CSV format
CSV_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.body: No rows were imported. Use the expected columns and numbers like 1.234,56 or 1234,56.

CUSTOMER_INCOMPLETE.title: Customer details are missing
CUSTOMER_INCOMPLETE.body: The reservation is saved. Add tax ID and phone to continue.

DIAGNOSTICS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Diagnostic unavailable
DIAGNOSTICS_UNAVAILABLE.body: The queue is still safe. Ask for a new diagnostic if you still need to investigate.

FORBIDDEN.title: You do not have access to this page
FORBIDDEN.body: Nothing changed. Go back to a page available for your role.

GUARD_AFTER_PHOTO_REQUIRED.title: After-repair photo needed
GUARD_AFTER_PHOTO_REQUIRED.body: The job is saved. Take one final photo of the machine to complete it.

GUARD_CHECKIN_INCOMPLETE.title: A return step is missing
GUARD_CHECKIN_INCOMPLETE.body: Your data is saved. Open the marked step and add what is missing.

GUARD_CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE.title: Checklist incomplete
GUARD_CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE.body: The job is saved. Answer the highlighted items and add the required photos.

GUARD_CHECKOUT_INCOMPLETE.title: A hand-over step is missing
GUARD_CHECKOUT_INCOMPLETE.body: Your data is saved. Open the marked step and add what is missing.

GUARD_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED.title: Add how this was resolved
GUARD_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED.body: Nothing was closed yet. Choose the resolution and save the note.

GUARD_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.title: Signature required
GUARD_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.body: The inspection is saved. Collect the signature or record the allowed alternative.

IMPORT_ROW_ERRORS.title: Some rows need review
IMPORT_ROW_ERRORS.body: Valid rows are not imported yet. Download the report, fix the file or confirm a partial import.

INBOUND_RENTAL_INCOMPLETE.title: Partner rental details are missing
INBOUND_RENTAL_INCOMPLETE.body: The draft is saved. Complete partner, machine, and site to continue.

INTERNAL.title: Sending paused for instability
INTERNAL.body: Your data is safe. The app will try again by itself.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.title: Email or password did not match
INVALID_CREDENTIALS.body: Check the details and try again. Your drafts on this device stay saved.

INVALID_TRANSITION.title: Step is no longer valid
INVALID_TRANSITION.body: Your work stayed saved. Review the current state and try the next available step.

INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH.title: Use the invited email
INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH.body: This {role} invite is for {emailHint}. Sign in with that account or ask for a new invite.

INVITE_EXPIRED.title: Invite expired or already used
INVITE_EXPIRED.body: Ask whoever invited you for a new one.

LAST_ADMIN.title: The company needs an Admin
LAST_ADMIN.body: Make someone else an Admin first.

LOCATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Confirm location use
LOCATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED.body: The office sees your location only while you are on duty. Without accepting, you stay off duty and your data stays saved.

MEDIA_LOCKED.title: File is already protected
MEDIA_LOCKED.body: The original attachment stays saved. View the sent item or ask the office to review it.

MEDIA_NOT_IN_STORAGE.title: Original video is still uploading
MEDIA_NOT_IN_STORAGE.body: The original video is still being sent. We show the preview and let you know when it finishes.

MEDIA_PART_MISSING.title: A piece of the file is missing
MEDIA_PART_MISSING.body: The file is safe. We’ll resend only the missing part.

MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.title: File is too large
MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.body: Your report is safe. Record a smaller video or send photos.

MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: File format does not match
MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH.body: Your report is safe. Choose another file or record again.

METER_READING_JUMP.title: Check the hour meter
METER_READING_JUMP.body: The job is saved. Fix the reading, confirm the jump or mark that the meter was replaced with a photo.

METER_READING_LOWER.title: Check the hour meter
METER_READING_LOWER.body: The job is saved. Fix the reading, confirm the jump or mark that the meter was replaced with a photo.

NOT_FOUND.title: Record not found
NOT_FOUND.body: It may have been removed or archived. Your filters and current work are safe.

OAUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR.title: Google/Apple didn't respond
OAUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR.body: Try again shortly or sign in with email and password.

OFFICE_ROLE_REQUIRED.title: The office is for Admins and Managers
OFFICE_ROLE_REQUIRED.body: Use the AgroRende app on your phone. Need access? Talk to your admin.

ORG_SUSPENDED.title: Company access paused
ORG_SUSPENDED.body: Keep recording: everything stays saved and will send when the company is back.

PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.title: Change your password to continue
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.body: This change needs internet only this time. What you already did stays saved.

PLOT_GEOMETRY_INVALID.title: Review the plot on the map
PLOT_GEOMETRY_INVALID.body: Nothing was saved. Adjust the area or mark the correct point.

RATE_LIMITED.title: We’ll send in small groups
RATE_LIMITED.body: Your data is safe. There are many requests right now, so the app will wait a little.

RECORD_IN_USE.title: This record has history
RECORD_IN_USE.body: Nothing was deleted. Archive it to hide it without losing reports, costs or rentals.

REFRESH_REUSED.title: Session protected
REFRESH_REUSED.body: For safety, sign in again on this device. Your local data stays saved.

RENTAL_ASSET_MISMATCH.title: This is not the rental machine
RENTAL_ASSET_MISMATCH.body: The inspection is saved. Scan the right machine or type the code.

RENTAL_BILLING_DOCUMENT_FAILED.title: Billing is not ready
RENTAL_BILLING_DOCUMENT_FAILED.body: The rental is saved. Try again or let the office finish it.

RENTAL_CHARGES_UPDATED.title: Totals updated by the office
RENTAL_CHARGES_UPDATED.body: Your inspection is saved. Review the updated amounts before closing.

RENTAL_DAMAGE_REPORT_FAILED.title: Damage saved for review
RENTAL_DAMAGE_REPORT_FAILED.body: The return is saved. The office will create the report if needed.

RENTAL_DATES_INVALID.title: Check the rental dates
RENTAL_DATES_INVALID.body: Your data is saved. Use a future date and an end after the start.

RENTAL_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Rental is not active
RENTAL_NOT_ACTIVE.body: The return inspection was kept. The office was notified.

RENTAL_NOT_FOUND.title: Rental not found
RENTAL_NOT_FOUND.body: Your local data stays saved. Refresh the list or ask the office for help.

RENTAL_NOT_RESERVED.title: Rental is no longer reserved
RENTAL_NOT_RESERVED.body: Your photos and signatures were kept. The office was notified.

RENTAL_SITE_MISMATCH.title: Machine is at another site
RENTAL_SITE_MISMATCH.body: Your data is saved. Choose delivery, change the site, or ask the office.
RENTAL_SITE_MISMATCH.action: Switch to delivery or pick site

REPORT_LOCKED.title: Report is already protected
REPORT_LOCKED.body: Your report stays saved. View the history or ask the office to review it.

RESET_LINK_EXPIRED.title: Link expired
RESET_LINK_EXPIRED.body: Request a new link and try again. No device data was deleted.

RESET_REQUIRED.title: Your access changed
RESET_REQUIRED.body: We will update what you can see. What you already recorded stays saved.

SEASON_OVERLAP.title: Season dates overlap
SEASON_OVERLAP.body: Nothing was saved. Adjust the dates or choose a different crop.

STORAGE_FULL.title: File sending paused
STORAGE_FULL.body: Your files are safe on this device. We’ll try again when there is room.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_IN_USE.title: The new version applies from now on
TEMPLATE_VERSION_IN_USE.body: Work already in progress stays safe on the old version.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: Sign in again to send
TOKEN_EXPIRED.body: You can keep working. Your items stay saved until you sign in.

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Sign in to continue
UNAUTHENTICATED.body: Your drafts on this device stay saved. Sign in with the same account to send.

UNKNOWN_MUTATION.title: Update to send this action
UNKNOWN_MUTATION.body: The action stayed saved. Update AgroRende and send diagnostics if it continues.

UPLOAD_URL_EXPIRED.title: Sending took too long
UPLOAD_URL_EXPIRED.body: The file is safe. The app will ask for a new path and continue.

VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Update to send this item
VALIDATION_FAILED.body: The item is saved. Update AgroRende and try sending again.

WO_ALREADY_VERIFIED.title: This job was already verified
WO_ALREADY_VERIFIED.body: Your work is saved as extra evidence. The office will review it if needed.

WO_ASSET_RETIRED.title: Asset is retired
WO_ASSET_RETIRED.body: The job is saved. The office received the review request; go back to Today for now.

WO_ASSIGNEE_OFF_DUTY.title: Assignee is off duty
WO_ASSIGNEE_OFF_DUTY.body: The job was not lost. Choose someone on duty or confirm the assignment with a warning.

WO_CANCELLED.title: This job was cancelled
WO_CANCELLED.body: Your photos and notes are safe and were sent to the office as evidence.

WO_DESTINATION_MISSING.title: Job location missing
WO_DESTINATION_MISSING.body: The job is saved. Call the customer or ask the office for the location.

WO_PART_NOT_IN_VAN_STOCK.title: Part is not in your van
WO_PART_NOT_IN_VAN_STOCK.body: The job is saved. Use free text, put the job on hold for parts or request a transfer.

WO_REASSIGNED.title: This job went to another assignee
WO_REASSIGNED.body: Your work is saved and the office was notified.

WO_SAFETY_STOP_REQUIRED.title: Stop for safety
WO_SAFETY_STOP_REQUIRED.body: The job is saved. Put it on hold for safety and notify the office.
